experience.role: Sr. SAP Consultant – Order to Cash Specialist
highlights: Worked on SAP SD functional changes and O2C process improvements for the Apple account, partnering with global business, IS&T, logistics, and integration teams to translate operational requirements into system changes.

Gathered requirements from order management, fulfilment, warehouse, and logistics stakeholders by reviewing process flows, business scenarios, existing system behaviour, exceptions, and downstream dependencies; documented functional requirements and acceptance criteria for CRs.

Handled SAP SD change requests and enhancement activities, assessing business impact, identifying affected configuration and interfaces, coordinating functional and technical actions, and supporting testing through deployment.

Worked on 3PL and carrier integration scenarios involving Blue Dart, DHL, and FedEx for the Apple account, coordinating delivery/shipment data, carrier/service information, tracking or waybill references, and shipment status issues.
Supported warehouse and logistics integration flows across SAP, TMS 2.0, ProShip, and SAP Enterprise Portal, analysing data hand-offs across order, delivery, shipping, and carrier processes.

Worked hands-on with SAP IDoc messages using WE02 and WE05 to review status/data, analyse processing errors, and reprocess failed IDocs through BD87; worked with partner profiles in WE20 and supported EDI validation and interface testing.

Supported SAP SD configuration and enhancement areas including Variant Configuration, item category determination, and ATP, assessing impacts on delivery creation, warehouse processing, and downstream logistics.

Prepared and executed functional and integration test scenarios for CRs and performed root-cause analysis for SAP SD and integration incidents with ABAP, middleware, warehouse, TMS, and carrier teams.
